lines: Follow the water to the Falls.
Follow the chalk down to the Lamp.

entries.where: Survey Handbook p1; poster in the first room
lines: Do not panic. Everyone does it once.
2. Levels do not connect like rooms.
Walk out of one and you are in the next.
3. Scan the same place twice and it lies less.
margin: Walls drift when nobody looks. -T.W.
They do not know it. Do not stand near them.
5. Every scan is a noise. Some things listen for it.
margin: Run and you are shouting. -T.W.
6. Never run toward a sound you cannot place.
7. Base will ask what you see.
Base will never tell you to come to her.
8. Crew greet with two taps, a breath, then one.
9. Lamps wake when scanned. Scan every one you find.
margin: A bag that glows was hung by a friend. -J.B.
10. Stay where someone can see you.
A person nobody sees starts to fade.
11. Exits exist. We have not found one.
12. Someone has to keep the lamp.
entries.speaker: Ines Calder

entries.where: Bulletin on the first-room wall; level title card follows
lines: What: a forgotten workplace, after hours.
Hazards: the Pacer. You will hear keys.
entries.thought: Level zero. So there are more.

entries.where: Bulletin at the stair down; level title card follows
lines: What: drowned utilities. The water is safe to wade.

entries.thought: Wade, don't linger. Fine. I'll be quick.

entries.where: Painted board at the Falls entrance

lines: Hazards: the Echo. It answers back.
entries.thought: A hospital. Great. Dark, empty, and it answers back.

entries.where: Bulletin at the cave mouth; level title card follows
lines: What: a cave that grows around what it holds.
Hazards: the Still. It moves when you look away.
entries.thought: A cave inside a building inside whatever this is.

entries.where: Bulletin on a concrete pillar; level title card follows
lines: What: a parking structure that only goes down.
entries.thought: Down. Always down. And all of them, at once.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): on waking
lines: Halden Building, floor 3. I put my hand on the wall and there was no wall.
Now I am somewhere yellow and wet. Scanner still works. Start there.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after the orientation tape
lines: Ines runs the Survey. She wants a true scan of a real place.
I have forty-one of floor three.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after the orientation tape
lines: Red dots were people. Green dots are people still.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Joss
lines: Joss Berrow. Rigger. Cheerful in a way that worries me.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after the Halden tape
lines: The Halden Building had a door on floor 3 that was not on the plan.
A man in a Corbel and Pike jacket stood next to it in 1994. That is my company.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after the Hollis tape
lines: Hollis, night security. Still doing his rounds. Nobody can see him, so he fades.
That is what fading is. Nobody sees you, so you stop being you.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Hana
lines: Hana Osei, hydrologist. The water leads to the Falls.
Tobi Wren went quiet so nothing would hear him. Now nothing can. He is the Hush.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Lena
lines: The Falls holds because everyone remembers a place like it.
There is a space on the roster for me.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Ravi
lines: Ravi Anand. The Echo copies his voice. It cannot copy the pause.
The scanner head in the Survey's rig is from Corbel and Pike. Serial 0007. Mine is 0041.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Pim
lines: Pim Ashworth, youngest in the Survey. Keeps the Hollow lit for whoever comes next.
Quill is the Still. He took forty photographs of it. In the thirtieth it was closer.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after the Pike tape
lines: Anselm Pike, Corbel and Pike, 1994. First one through. Unit 0007.
He says a true scan of the real floor will match the cloud. I have forty-one.

entries.where: Theo's journal (unlocks as learned): after Ines
lines: A forgotten place stops belonging to the world. Halden was empty ten years.
I was the last to look at it, forty-one times. That is why it let me in, and why I can leave.

lines: THE WALLS MOVED WHILE WE SLEPT.

lines: FOLLOW IT UPSTREAM. IT ENDS SOMEWHERE LIT. -H.O.
entries.thought: Follow the water upstream. Okay. That's a plan.

entries.where: Headphones on a pipe with a sticky note
entries.thought: Quiet kept him safe. Then it did not.
A polite way to say it.

entries.where: Valve station with the wheel missing

Hana counted the water. She's been here a long time.

entries.where: Hand-drawn chart of the water's route

entries.thought: She mapped the whole route. All I have to do is not die on it.

entries.where: Alcove behind the waterfall: mural of every Level in a stack
entries.thought: Stack of Levels. And a dotted line going up. That's the exit nobody's found.

lines: Everyone signs. Nobody says what for.
entries.thought: Everyone signs. That's how you know you're still here.

entries.where: PA speaker above a nurse station

lines: (scratched below) IF IT DOES NOT BREATHE, IT IS NOT US.
entries.thought: Remember the breath.

lines: ONCE TO CARRY SOMEONE IN. THE NAME IS CROSSED OUT.
entries.thought: Carried in, never out. The dark things were staff once.
Cut the wire. Nobody wants the thing to know where they are.

lines: It has my voice, so I keep it dead. -R.A.

entries.where: Halden door frame grown into cave rock

entries.where: Camera on a tripod facing the passage

lines: ROPE BRIDGE. ONE AT A TIME.

entries.where: Row of mugs on a ledge

lines: NOTHING HERE IS OLDER THAN THIS STONE.
EVERY LEVEL HANGS FROM IT. THE LAMP IS BELOW.

scenes.title: The Halden Building

beats.line: Last scan. Forty-one of forty-one. Pack up, go home.
Wait. That's not--
This is not floor three. Nobody sent me here. Scan the room. Find a door.

scenes.note: About 30 seconds. Staged in the client (Stage.luau, set office): scanner sweeps the floor, Theo leans on the wall, it melts, black, the title, a low shot of the melted wall. Ends on the first playable frame.

scenes.title: Survey Orientation (Tape 1 of 9)
scenes.where: CRT/VCR in the first room (poi.l0.vcr); lit and playable on the first dot

beats.shot: CRT static. A woman at a desk with a banker's lamp. Camcorder angle, slightly too low. Wall maps behind her.

beats.line: Hello. If you are watching this, you came through a wall. Everyone does.
I am Ines. I run the Survey. Your scanner makes no light. It makes a record.
Dots stay where you look. Mapped space holds still. The rest drifts.
Find my people. Every Level has a camp, and each camp knows something you need.

beats.shot: She reaches forward. The tape cuts to static.

beats.line: I am not Survey. I just scanned the wrong wall. Fine. Find the surveyors.

scenes.note: Five spoken lines. It does not explain the Backrooms (Joss does, once), the colours (the intake hint does) or the exit (Pike's tape and the finale do). Journal entries 02 and 03 unlock.

scenes.title: Halden Building: Where Tomorrow Works
scenes.where: VCR in the Level 0 break room

beats.shot: A promo VHS from 1994, saturated colour. Fast pans of a glass lobby, escalators, an atrium with a fountain.

beats.line: Halden Building. Fifteen floors of tomorrow.

beats.shot: Camera drifts down a corridor, floor three. At the very end is a door that is not on any plan. It is slightly open. Light is coming out of it.

beats.line: From the lobby to floor... three...

beats.shot: Tape glitches. Static. End.

beats.line: Fifteen floors. My plan said fourteen. And that door is on my floor.

scenes.title: Security Camera 4 (night)
scenes.where: Monitor in the Level 0 security booth

beats.shot: Grey security footage. A man in a security jacket, keys on his belt, walks the corridor with a flashlight.

beats.line: Round one. All quiet.

beats.shot: Time jumps. Same corridor. The carpet is wetter. The man is a little translucent. The footage loses detail where he stands.

beats.line: Round eleven thousand. I do not see the other guards any more. Can anyone see me?

beats.shot: The man stops. Looks straight into the camera. The footage keeps going, but he is gone from the frame. Keys, faint, continue.

beats.line: Nobody saw him, so he started to disappear.

scenes.title: Walkman Diary: T. Wren
scenes.where: Cassette player in the Level 1 pump room

beats.shot: A cassette player on a shelf, red record light. Water dripping in the background, very close to the mic.

beats.line: Tobi Wren. I can hear the building thinking. So I stopped talking.

beats.shot: Longer silence. Dripping. A faint, patient breath.

beats.line: It worked. I could not hear anyone, and nobody could hear me.
That's the problem.
He went quiet so nothing would find him. Then nothing could.

scenes.title: Ravi's Demonstration
scenes.where: TV in the Level 2 day room

beats.shot: A ward day room. Ravi, nervous, sits close to the camera. A radio on the table.

beats.line: This is the Echo. Watch. Two taps. A breath. One.

beats.shot: He taps the table. Silence. Then, from the dark behind the camera, two taps. No breath. One tap.

beats.line: Ravi? Ravi? Ravi?
It copies the words. It copies the taps. It cannot wait.
It doesn't breathe. That is the tell.

beats.shot: A slide projector throws images on the cave wall: a corridor, frame by frame.

beats.line: Frame one. Empty corridor. Frame ten. Empty.
Frame thirty. A shape at the far end.

beats.shot: A shape at the end of the corridor, drawn closer in each frame.

beats.line: It moves when I do not look. So I look. But if I stare, it learns the stare.
Watch it. Then step. Never stare.

scenes.title: Tape 9 of 9: A. Pike
scenes.where: Camcorder on the folding table in the Garage

beats.shot: A young man in a Corbel and Pike jacket. Same face as the ribbon-cutting. Sodium light. A small lamp beside him.

beats.line: Day one. Anselm Pike. I scanned the wall at the end of floor three, and the wall opened.
Down here there is a light. I call it the Lamp.
Bring a true scan of the real floor three, and the shape will match. A door will open.
He was first. Unit 0007. And I have the real floor.

scenes.title: Joss Berrow
scenes.trigger: Walk up to the green dot; scene plays; he hands over lamp-bags

beats.line: Whoa. Easy. You are real. Green dots, good. Sit.
Where am I?
The Backrooms. Every Level is a place somebody forgot.
Take these lamp-bags. Hang one at every turn, scan it, it wakes up.
The way down needs a fuse. Breaker room, past the vending machines.

scenes.note: Gives: lamp-bags. Journal 04. Unlocks goal.l0b. Hollis, time and Hana are told elsewhere (thought.keys, Lena, the HUD goal).

scenes.title: Hana Osei

beats.line: Sit. Keep your voice down. Water carries.
The water runs up a shaft to the Falls. Always follow it.
The thing in the pipes is Tobi. He went quiet. Now he is the Hush.
Walk past him. Never run. Never ping.
The valve wheel is in the boiler room. Drain the channel, then go.

scenes.note: Gives: pencil map, rope hint. Journal 07.

scenes.title: Lena Sorrel

beats.line: Theo. We heard you coming. Come in. Eat.
This is the Falls. Everyone remembers a place like it, so the dark cannot rewrite it.
Joss says thirty years. Time down here is a rumour.
When the dark takes you, you wake at the last lamp. That is Ines. It costs her. Fall less.
Take the Brass Key. It opens the Ward doors.

scenes.note: Gives: Brass Key, the respawn explanation. Journal 08. Unlocks thought.respawn.ines.

scenes.title: Ravi Anand
scenes.trigger: Tap twice at the curtain, wait, tap once; scene plays

beats.line: (whisper) Good. You waited. Come in. Quick.
The Wards is where voices end up. The Echo learns them. It learned mine.
The crank for the lift is in the Dormitory. Take it.
The Hollow is up. Pim keeps a light there.

scenes.title: Pim Ashworth

beats.line: You made it. Nobody makes it. Come sit.
I keep the lanterns lit so people can find camp. Best job ever.
Quill took forty photographs of the Hollow. He thought it would hold still.
Ines is at the bottom. Take the Lamp Core from the last bay.
See you up there, Theo. I mean it.

scenes.note: Gives: the Lamp Core clue, flash bulb. Journal 10.

scenes.title: Ines Calder
scenes.trigger: Walk up to the green dot

beats.shot: A tall dome. A great brass Lamp. A woman at a desk looks up. Green dot, steady. Her eyes find Theo's scanner first.

beats.line: Theo. Good. The dots held.
Ines. You pulled me back.
{deaths} times. Each night, a little further.
You never fell. That is not luck. That is care.
Put the unit to the board. Forty-one scans. I watched every one.

beats.shot: Theo places his scanner on the chalkboard rig. The board fills with white dots: every scan the Survey ever made. A gap, the shape of a corridor, glows.

beats.line: A forgotten place leaves the world. You looked forty-one times. So you can leave.

beats.shot: The unit's scan slides into the gap. A line of light runs up the ladder shaft. A real door, edges of daylight.

beats.line: The ladder goes up. Or sit with me. Someone has to keep the lamp.

beats.shot: Two choices. Climb, or take the lamp.

scenes.note: Ends with choice.up / choice.stay. Journal 12. Six spoken lines for any one player (the falls count is one line or the other).

scenes.title: Up

beats.shot: Theo climbs. The air changes first: cold, clean, damp with rain.
A door. He steps through. Halden Building, floor three, early light. The wall is a wall.

beats.line: It's morning.

beats.shot: He checks his phone. Time: 11:43 PM. One minute after he leaned on the wall.

beats.line: One minute.

beats.shot: He looks at the plaque in the stairwell: HALDEN BUILDING. FIFTEEN FLOORS.

beats.line: Fifteen.

beats.shot: Behind him, the scanner chimes. SCAN 42 OF 42 BEGINNING. Nobody pressed anything.
Card: THE BACKROOMS: MAPPED. Credits. Next run: Night Shift +.

scenes.note: The stinger: fifteen floors, and a scan starting by itself. Keeps the mystery open.

scenes.title: The Lamp

beats.shot: Theo takes the Lamp's handle. It is heavier than it looks. Ines lets go.

beats.line: It listens to whoever is looking at it. That is the whole trick.
Somebody will wake up scared in an office tomorrow. I would want a light.

beats.shot: The ladder is still there. He does not climb it.
Card: THE RELAY. Floor 1. Each floor is lit by the last person to pass it.

scenes.note: Starts endless mode. The daily seed is tonight's floor.

voices.Theo: late 20s to early 30s, tired, dry humour that cracks under pressure; speaks to himself, never to camera
voices.Ines: 50s to 60s, calm, low, unhurried; teacher voice; never raises it; radio filter on Base lines
voices.Joss: 40s, warm, fast, jokes to cover nerves; workshop clatter behind him
voices.Hana: 30s, flat, practical, short sentences; hates speeches
voices.Lena: 30s, generous, loud-quiet; sounds like she just laughed
voices.Ravi: 20s, whispery, jumpy; keeps glancing at the radio
voices.Pim: late teens or 20, bright, too hopeful; tries not to sound scared
voices.Hollis: 60s, gentle night-guard patter; professional; fades to a murmur
voices.Tobi: 30s, soft, careful; each tape quieter than the last
voices.Quill: 40s, deliberate, precise; sentences end like shutter clicks
voices.Pike: late 20s, 1994, cheerful engineer's voice that stays cheerful through the worst thing
voices.Announcer: 1994 corporate promo voice, smooth, bright, slightly too slow
voices.Echo: a copy of Ravi's voice but missing the pauses; speaks half a beat early
voices.Base?: Ines's radio voice, but with no static artefacts and no questions: only commands
